title: Igitangaza cy'ibimenyetso bitagira icyo bivuga
intro: Uhura n'inkuru itwikiriwe n'umuntu ivuga ku bufasha bw'Imana. Inkuru ivuga ku byo Imana yagukoreye mu buryo bw'igitangaza n'uburyo bwo kwiregura butagira icyo buvuga, bugaruka uko ibihe byagiye bihita. Ese ushobora kumenya uwahuye n'iki kigeragezo kidasanzwe?
clues: Nakiriye ubutumwa buturutse ku Mana bwatumye ntangazwa
Abantu banjye babajije ku isuku yanjye ubwo nagarukaga nzanye umwana
Nategetswe kwiyiriza ubusa kuva mu kuvuga igihe runaka
Isoko y'amazi n'amateke byankomeje mu gihe cy'urubanza rwanjye
Umwami wanjye yateje igiti mu buryo bw'igitangaza kugira ngo ampe ibyo nkeneye
Marayika yanyeretse mu ishusho y'umuntu utunganye

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Ubwiza bwanjye bwagaragaye igihe umuhungu wanjye w'uruhinja yavugaga
outcome.answer: Ubwiza bwanjye bwagaragaye igihe umuhungu wanjye w'uruhinja yavugaga

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
